summary: This directory contains the test suite for the internal configuration loading and processing logic. It ensures the correctness of configuration parsing, environment loading, data merging, and option filtering mechanisms prior to final usage by the application.
responsibilities: Verify the integrity of raw configuration decoding
Test environmental and static configuration loading processes
Validate the merging logic for multiple configuration sources
Ensure proper sorting and filtering of configuration options
relationships: The test suite validates the logic responsible for loading and merging data from different configuration sources.
Data processing functions like sorting and filtering are verified to ensure configuration options are correctly prepared for the application.
designDecisions: Co-location of unit and integration tests for internal utilities
Isolation of configuration logic from runtime dependencies
